# Orvio 0.29

- Smoother with several playlists: reading your saved playlists no longer waits on a large library loading in the background, which could freeze the screen after a sync or refresh.
- Faster search: typing on narrows the previous results instead of searching the whole library again.
- Faster player for series and a lighter Home screen: less work while playing and when your watch history changes.
- Genre filters and the Search filter no longer reset when you open a playlist in Settings.
- Settings always opens on its home page.
- A channel whose guide fails to load is retried after a minute instead of on every scroll.
